entries.core_move: Convert delayed and piecewise continuous-time signals into one-sided Laplace-domain expressions by choosing between direct integration and the time-shifting property.

Compute the one-sided Laplace transform of a piecewise signal by choosing between shifted-unit-step rewriting and derivative-based transformation, including the effects of discontinuities and initial values.
Apply the one-sided derivative property to a known derivative signal and algebraically isolate $X(s)$ while preserving the required initial-value term.
Reconstruct the causal time-domain signal from a solved $X(s)$ by decomposing it into known one-sided Laplace pairs and converting each term back to its time-domain component.

entries.lesson_title: Checking Initial and Final Behavior from a Transform
entries.core_move: Apply the initial- and final-value theorems to a one-sided Laplace transform $X(s)$ by verifying pole conditions and using transform-domain limits to check starting and steady-state behavior.
